overall.verdict: Light desktop is a calm two-column shell with a real bilateral bar and strong Pay/Account trust copy, but it is not yet a shipping fintech surface: money bars do not share one pixel scale, Home and Activity drown the total in legends and chips, and Swap/Receipt/Receive fail the visceral-value brief. Light theme contrast is acceptable, yet chrome (pills, hub chips, triple labels) keeps it from feeling expensive.
priority_fixes: Enforce one absolute bar scale (1 px = $N) on Home total, token row, Hub One, Pay debit, Activity ±amounts, and Receive capacity; fade overflow, never restack widths per card.
Home: delete the On-chain/Reserve/Accounts dollar legend and Instant send/receive duplicate; one stacked bar under the total, bilateral numbers only on the account bar.
Collapse Pay/Receive/Swap (and Account’s three pills) to one primary action; treat the rest as ghost/text.
Receipt: human time, copyable proof, a $25-scale bar; remove 1970 ms / 02:00:48 debug.
Swap: never present 0.00 receive + dead Swap; quote or explicit empty, and hatch the 100 USDC hold on the Hub One bar.
